api.query_cache_state: (paths: nonempty list/tuple<=1024 absolute regular files, allowed_roots: list/tuple absolute directories, deadline: finite absolute time.monotonic)->dict
api.evict_file_cache: (paths: nonempty list/tuple<=1024 absolute regular files, allowed_roots: list/tuple absolute directories, deadline: finite absolute time.monotonic)->dict
api.warm_file_cache: (paths: nonempty list/tuple<=1024 absolute regular files, allowed_roots: list/tuple absolute directories, deadline: finite absolute time.monotonic)->dict

result_schema.admission: query admitted=None; evict admitted=all_cold; warm admitted=all_hot where pages>0. Caller must require actual all0/allpages, not advisory return.

tests.scope: Real mincore/fadvise/read on tiny temporary owned files only, plus targeted mocked errors/credential branches. No actual privilege changes.

checks: zero file no map; not fake-hot with zero pages
fd opened O_RDONLY for exact fadvise targets and page-rounded advisory range
fadvise success cannot substitute residency gate
duplicate inode, missing, relative, outside root, symlink, directory, FIFO rejection
opened-fd redirection rejected before cache advice
mtime identity race and unreadable errors fail
mincore trusted owner or real FOWNER proof; conservative fullidentity uidmap/euidfsuid verification
deadline pre/post syscall fail without admission
short read and actual error propagation; primary mincore error preserved over secondary cleanup error
Real tiny-file reads plus mocked kernel mincore state: reading B evicts A; final query detects A0 and denies all_hot. Old interleaved algorithm would query A before the eviction.
limits: Cooperative syscall deadline checks only; existing independent process guardian required for hard runtime bound
Residency is a changing local-client snapshot, not pinning or a global atomic all-file state
No NFS server cache or physical storage cold proof
No real checkpoint, archive, Store, GPU, large warming, installation or Git operation performed
Formal sample counts, order and acceptance protocol are owned by parent; this is component evidence only
v2_delta: Complete every finite-manifest warm/evict operation before a separate whole-manifest query-only admission pass. No large reads between admission queries. Per-file read_bytes retained.
